archimate:ApplicationInterface.name: investment to GL
archimate:ApplicationInterface.documentation: Investment Accounting to GL (Subledger Journal Entries) Direction: Aladdin ⟶ ERP GL Payload: Aggregated journal entries reflecting portfolio activities over an accounting period (daily, weekly, or monthly). Components Transferred: Realized and unrealized gains/losses. Accrued interest, dividend income, and amortization of bond premiums/discounts. Mark-to-market (MTM) fair-value balance sheet adjustments. Corporate actions (stock splits, mergers, spin-offs). Format: Mapped directly to the ERP’s Chart of Accounts (CoA), tagged by Legal Entity, Fund Code, Cost Center, Currency, and Trading Book.
